description: How wide and tall a TV stand a TV needs: about 3 inches wider than the screen on each side, and the seated eye height less half the screen's height, so the middle of the screen sits at eye level. Also how far to sit: 1.5 to 2.5 times the screen size. Gives the designer rule of thumb; the page linked in the answer shows the sources.

eye.description: Seated eye height from the floor, in inches. Default 42.

tv.description: The TV's advertised size (screen diagonal), in inches. Default 65.
